characters.name: Pip
characters.summary: A young mouse who likes inventing indoor games.
characters.appearance: Small grey mouse; round ears; blue waistcoat; long plain tail.
characters.backstory: Pip keeps scraps of paper for making games with Bea. He often imagines the whole game before he explains its first step.
characters.want: To make a game his friend will enjoy.
characters.need: To check what another player can understand, and revise when a plan is unclear.
characters.voice: Brief, enthusiastic ideas; repeats a phrase when excited.

facts.statement: Pip collects paper scraps for games.

characters.name: Bea
characters.summary: A young beetle who enjoys puzzles and asks clear questions.
characters.appearance: Small chestnut beetle; smooth oval shell; yellow boots on the two lowest feet. Keep six limbs consistent in any artwork.
characters.backstory: Bea and Pip meet in the Window Room to swap games. Bea enjoys taking a turn as both player and inventor.
characters.want: To join the treasure hunt and understand its clues.
characters.need: Room to say when she is puzzled without being hurried.
characters.voice: Calm, direct questions and short, playful replies.

facts.statement: Bea says when a clue is unclear.

locations.name: Window Room
locations.description: A shared indoor play room with a low round table, a tall umbrella stand, a window seat and two spare blue boots by the door. Keep their relative positions consistent across views.

world_rules.statement: These small animal friends speak and use household objects at a consistent storybook scale.

relationships.description: Friends who take turns inventing and trying each other’s games.

timeline.description: One rainy afternoon, Pip revises an indoor treasure map after Bea cannot follow it. The event belongs to a draft story.

glossary.notes: A familiar thing that helps you know where you are. Show the table, umbrella stand and boots in the art.

series_threads: A later game may let Bea invent and Pip try the clues; this is a possibility, not an established event.
